audit: ATLAS Sen1Floods11 hand-labeled chip footprint screen

method.geometry: STAC item bbox, compared to each fixed rectangular AOI bbox in WGS84
method.intersection_rule: strict positive-area bbox intersection; touching boundaries do not count
method.label_asset_only: LabelHand; weak labels and Sentinel-1-derived labels are excluded
limits: Footprint overlap is discovery evidence only; label raster values, valid-pixel fraction, label accuracy, event attribution, and temporal comparability were not inspected.
The dataset paper reports labels from hand review supported by Sentinel-2 classification; the labels are not claimed to be field observations.
No item footprints intersect the fixed ATLAS candidate AOIs, so the dataset supplies no directly matched validation chips for this area register.
